lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Manager!
Sup, Volume.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Well well!

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: You're much more hip with your slang now.
I've got you to thank for that.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Nice!
What's up?

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: I went to the waiting room

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: after my performance

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: and saw something weird on the table.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: I was wondering if it was something that you'd left.
What was it?

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: They were these red lumps in this super vivid red liquid.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: When I got a closer look, they seemed to be something that you could eat.
Ah, yes, those are mine.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: I knew it!

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: What are they, anyway?
They're called tteokbokki.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Come again?
Tteokbokki. They're made by boiling rice cakes in a spicy sauce.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: OMG! I've never heard of it.
It's a very common dish in the Ark.
It's a very luxurious food item.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Really? I find that hard to believe,

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: because this is the first time I've ever seen it.
That's because you're a big-shot celebrity.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: You must be joking.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: If that were the case, I would have tried it before.
Actually, I was kidding, hehe.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Aha!

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: From the looks of it, I didn't think I'd be a fan.
Looks can be deceiving. I'm sure it tasted fine when you had some, right?
You didn't try any?

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Umm...

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Other than how it looked, the smell was...
It should have smelled fine. I sealed them up tight.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: The instant I entered the waiting room,

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: I was punched in the face by the stench.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Far too strong for me.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: It was such an intense smell,

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: I couldn't take it...

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: and so I had a bite.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Um...
And? How was it?

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Not bad.
I knew you wouldn't be able to resist that kind of intensity.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Did you hear what I just said?

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: I said "Not bad", that's all. Not a ringing endorsement.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: However,

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: I think some of my staff might like it.
I'm sure they would.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: In that case,

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Manager,

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: could you prepare some for my next performance?
